caseName: Springfield, Ohio, Local No. 352 v. Settos
caseNameFull: Springfield, Ohio, Local No. 352, of the International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees v. Settos, Lessee
attorneys: Mr. Joseph A. Padway for petitioners. Messrs. A. C. Link and Samuel A. Bowman for respondent.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Ohio. It does not appear from the record that the federal *664question presented by the petition was necessarily decided by the court below. The petition for writ of cer-tiorari is denied. Lynch v. New York ex rel. Pierson, 293 U. S. 52; Honeyman v. Hanan, 300 U. S. 14, 18.

Mr. Joseph A. Padway for petitioners. Messrs. A. C. Link and Samuel A. Bowman for respondent.
